CONCENTRATION GENERALLY CONSISTS OF BREAKING BY HAND, HANDSORTING, AND HANDWASHING. THE MINES LISTED ARE CONSIDERED TO BE THE PRINCIPAL WORKINGS IN THE ORE, BUT THERE ARE MANY OTHER SMALL WORKINGS THAT CONTRIBUTE TO THE PRODUCTION.
